io.milvus.v2.utils

Class DataUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.utils.DataUtils

  • public class DataUtils
extends Object
    Helper for converting V2 insert/upsert/delete request data into gRPC requests. Validates row data against the collection schema and generates gRPC FieldData for normal, struct, and dynamic fields.
